description: GOES-physics: 14 KEEP + goes_T_iso + goes_EM + goes_dT_iso_15m = 17 features, V1 architecture
architecture: V1 PatchTST, n_features=17 (patch embedding width changes; all else frozen protocol)

spans.train: 2010-01-02..2019-12-31 (artifacts/research/train.parquet, rebuilt via V4 pipeline for F1)

evaluation.statistical_test: paired moving-block bootstrap; significance = 95% CI of delta excludes 0

preregistration.seed_escalation_rule: if across-seed TSS range > 0.015 on F1, escalate to 5 seeds before any verdict (07_EXTERNAL_REVIEW.md U1)
preregistration.primary_metric: paired delta True Skill Score (policy operating point)
preregistration.success_criterion: paired dTSS >= +0.02 with lower 95% bound > 0 in >= 2 of 3 seeds, pre-onset recall not degraded
preregistration.failure_criterion: criterion unmet in >= 2 of 3 seeds -> negative verdict; no post-hoc substitution permitted
preregistration.stopping_rules: Sprint 25 04_success_criteria.md triggers (a)-(e): prediction collapse, baseline reproduction failure, test-set access during selection, reproducibility failure, frozen-artifact modification
preregistration.cross_span_rule: all Aditya-relevant comparisons same-span paired on S2; F1-vs-F0 full-span reported separately

dataset: V1-era splits rebuilt through the V4 pipeline (03_DATASET_PIPELINE_V4.md; build scheduled Sprint 30)
